method: Focused behavior cloning initialized from diagonal policy; no new PPO
training: 10 demonstrations per 23/40/65 cm preset and 10 random diagonal scenes, seeds 43000-43009
validation: 20/20 at seeds 44000-44004, five per condition; fixed preset seeds repeat the same deterministic layouts
replay: 3/3 at seed 2000 versus previous 2/3; these fixed layouts were included in training
limits: Fixed upright 5 cm box, mass .08, friction 2, no obstacles. No arbitrary 65 cm layouts or hardware reliability established.
